messages:
incident-bot: Post-incident follow-up: RCA draft ready for review — https://docs.google.com/document/d/abcd1234

Elaine (oncall): I've put the draft in the doc, section "Impact & Timeline" has the first-pass timeline. Need legal to confirm the wording for affected customers before we publish. Suggested reviewers: Priya (SRE), Mike (Eng), Dan (PM), Sara (Legal). Please add comments by EOD Fri.

Priya (sre): I'll review the monitoring/mitigation sections. Quick note: the `kv-cache-exceeded` alert fired at 06:12 UTC and preceded the elevated latencies. I'll attach the alert query and graphs.

Mike (eng): I can flesh out the "root cause" and "mitigation" subsections. Can someone confirm the deployed commit hash?

Elaine (oncall): commit: `ab12f9d` — rolled at ~06:05 UTC. Rollback to previous at ~06:20 UTC. We saw 4 customers with spikes in request latency.

Dan (pm): I'll confirm the impacted-customer list and coordinate outreach cadence. Also need to know SLA exposure for those accounts.

Sara (legal): I'll review the "Customer impact" wording. Two asks: (1) keep statements factual and avoid speculative/broad admissions, (2) flag regulated customers (finance/health) so I can review compliance language. Send the customer list here or in the doc.

Priya (sre): Action (SRE): verify mitigation is durable, and add a circuit-breaker to the KV cache path. I'll open a PR and link it in the doc.

Mike (eng): Draft timeline (adding to doc):
```
06:02 UTC - autoscale event started (spike in load)
06:05 UTC - deploy `ab12f9d` rolled to canary/pool
06:12 UTC - `kv-cache-exceeded` alerts spike across shards
06:15 UTC - latency >2x baseline, ops triage begins
06:20 UTC - rollback to previous deploy
06:30 UTC - mitigation verification, latency trending to normal
06:45 UTC - monitoring OK, alert noise subsided
```

Elaine (oncall): We also observed short OOMs on several model shards ~06:11 for 12-18s; logs attached in the doc under "supporting logs".

Priya (sre): I'll attach Grafana graphs and the alert query. Also will validate that auto-retry paths didn't drop requests.

Elaine (oncall): Proposed reviewer deadlines: 
- Priya (SRE) — technical validation — due Thu 10:00 UTC
- Mike (Eng) — RCA writeup edits — due Thu 18:00 UTC
- Sara (Legal) — customer wording review — due Fri 12:00 UTC
- Dan (PM) — outreach & signoff — due Fri 16:00 UTC
Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept.

Mike (eng): :thumbsup:

Priya (sre): :thumbsup:

Dan (pm): I'll coordinate the outreach template and tracker.

Sara (legal): Added a couple inline suggestions already. Need the final impacted-customer list and confirmation there was no PII exposure; initial scan suggests none. Loop in @finance if outreach includes credits.

Elaine (oncall): Customer impact summary (draft):
- 4 customers observed transient latency >2x baseline for ~18 minutes
- No data corruption or persistent failures found
- All requests were either served or retried successfully; no queued requests were lost

Dan (pm): For outreach I recommend proactive email + scheduled 1:1 for the top 2 affected customers. I'll draft the copy in the doc and share for legal review.

Mike (eng): Adding "Contributing factors" bullets to the doc: rapid config churn during autoscale, insufficient KV cache throttling, missing high-water-mark memory guard on shards.

Priya (sre): Open action items (from this thread):
- SRE: add KV cache circuit-breaker & alerts — owner: Priya — PR#3421 — due Mon
- Eng: implement per-shard HWM guard & memory accounting — owner: Mike — PR#3425 — due Tue
- Ops: update runbook for autoscale failure modes — owner: Elaine — ticket PMT-788 — due Wed
- Legal: sign off customer wording — owner: Sara — due Fri
- PM: customer outreach + tracking — owner: Dan — due Fri

Elaine (oncall): I'll create JIRA tickets and link PRs and the doc.

Sara (legal): FYI: if the outreach mentions SLA credits, finance needs to be looped in — pinging @finance in the doc.

Dan (pm): noted, I'll add finance to the thread and outreach plan.

Priya (sre): Severity recommendation: Sev-2 (significant customer impact, no data loss). Any objections?

Mike (eng): Agree Sev-2.

Elaine (oncall): Noted Sev-2. Final request: reviewers, please paste comments directly into the doc and reply here with sign-off so we can proceed to ops review and publish.

Dan (pm): On the doc now, ETA Thu EOD for my review.

Mike (eng): Engineering section edits complete; left a couple inline clarifying questions.

Priya (sre): Uploaded dashboards & alert queries to the doc. :white_check_mark:

Sara (legal): Added comments and one rephrase suggestion to the final paragraph. I pinged finance about potential SLA implications.

Elaine (oncall): Thanks all. Plan: consolidate Thursday morning, finalize Friday after legal. Target publish: Fri 18:00 UTC. If anything blocks sign-off, escalate here.

incident-bot: Reminder: RCA doc link pinned and action items synced to #incidents-jira.

Elaine (oncall): Closing thread for now — will repost when ready for sign-off. :lock:
